description: This file defines and exports a list of optional bundled cluster names, along with functions to check cluster inclusion, environment-based build decisions, and validation of installed packages related to optional bundled clusters.

methods.name: isOptionalBundledCluster
methods.description: Checks if a given cluster name is part of the optional bundled clusters set.

methods.name: shouldIncludeOptionalBundledClusters
methods.description: Determines whether optional bundled clusters should be included based on environment variable.

methods.name: hasReleasedBundledInstall
methods.description: Checks if there is a valid, non-empty npmSpec string in packageJson indicating a released bundled install.

methods.name: shouldBuildBundledCluster
methods.description: Decides if a specific cluster should be built, considering existing install info, environment settings, and cluster status.
